notes.subject: Bind up the testimony
notes.rationale: imperatives addressed to Isaiah (deposit the testimony with his disciples) or read as third person ‘it is bound up’ — the imperative is the plain form

notes.subject: to Isaiah
notes.rationale: two imperatives open the verse — commands to bind and seal

notes.subject: seal the teaching
notes.rationale: sealing connotes both authenticity and withholding — the testimony kept for the disciples until its time

notes.subject: testimony
notes.rationale: תְּעוּדָה occurs only here and in Isaiah 8:20 and Ruth 4:7 in the Tanakh

translation: Bind up the testimony, seal the teaching among my disciples.
